name: Advanced
description: B2 · C1 · C2 — Upper-Intermediate to Mastery vocabulary

words.definition: Facing a growing level of danger or risk from something.
words.definitionUz: Increasingly threatened by — biror narsa tomonidan tobora kuchayib borayotgan xavf ostida qolmoq.
words.example1: Polar bears are increasingly threatened by melting ice.
words.example1Translation: Qutb ayiqlari eriyotgan muzlar tufayli tobora ko‘proq tahdid ostida.
words.example2: Many species are increasingly threatened by habitat loss.
words.example2Translation: Ko‘plab turlar yashash joylarining yo‘qolishi bilan tobora ko‘proq tahdid ostida.
words.example3: Coastal cities are increasingly threatened by rising sea levels.
words.example3Translation: Sohil bo‘yidagi shaharlar dengiz sathining ko‘tarilishi bilan tobora ko‘proq tahdid ostida.
extraExamples: Coral reefs are increasingly threatened by ocean warming.
Farmers feel increasingly threatened by unpredictable weather.
Wildlife is increasingly threatened by human expansion.
Small islands are increasingly threatened by storms.
Ancient forests are increasingly threatened by logging.
Local communities are increasingly threatened by drought.
Bird populations are increasingly threatened by pollution.
extraExampleTranslations: Marjon riflari okean isishi bilan tobora ko‘proq tahdid ostida.
Fermerlar oldindan aytib bo‘lmaydigan ob-havo tufayli tobora ko‘proq tahdid ostida his qilmoqda.
Yovvoyi tabiat insonning kengayishi bilan tobora ko‘proq tahdid ostida.
Kichik orollar bo‘ronlar bilan tobora ko‘proq tahdid ostida.
Qadimiy o‘rmonlar daraxt kesish bilan tobora ko‘proq tahdid ostida.
Mahalliy jamoalar qurg‘oqchilik bilan tobora ko‘proq tahdid ostida.
Qush populyatsiyalari ifloslanish bilan tobora ko‘proq tahdid ostida.

words.definition: The results or impacts caused by long-term shifts in global temperatures and weather patterns.
words.definitionUz: The effects of climate change — global harorat va ob-havo naqshlaridagi uzoq muddatli o‘zgarishlar keltirib chiqaradigan natijalar yoki ta’sirlar.
words.example1: Scientists study the effects of climate change on ecosystems.
words.example1Translation: Olimlar iqlim o‘zgarishi oqibatlarini ekotizimlarga ta’sirini o‘rganadi.
words.example2: The effects of climate change are visible in melting glaciers.
words.example2Translation: Iqlim o‘zgarishi oqibatlari eriyotgan muzliklarda ko‘rinadi.
words.example3: Farmers suffer from the effects of climate change every year.
words.example3Translation: Fermerlar har yili iqlim o‘zgarishi oqibatlaridan aziyat chekadi.
extraExamples: The effects of climate change include stronger storms.
Children learn about the effects of climate change in school.
The effects of climate change threaten food security.
Researchers measure the effects of climate change carefully.
The effects of climate change are felt worldwide.
Cities prepare for the effects of climate change.
The effects of climate change harm marine life.
extraExampleTranslations: Iqlim o‘zgarishi oqibatlariga kuchliroq bo‘ronlar kiradi.
Bolalar maktabda iqlim o‘zgarishi oqibatlari haqida o‘rganadi.
Iqlim o‘zgarishi oqibatlari oziq-ovqat xavfsizligiga tahdid soladi.
Tadqiqotchilar iqlim o‘zgarishi oqibatlarini diqqat bilan o‘lchaydi.
Iqlim o‘zgarishi oqibatlari butun dunyoda seziladi.
Shaharlar iqlim o‘zgarishi oqibatlariga tayyorlanmoqda.
Iqlim o‘zgarishi oqibatlari dengiz hayotiga zarar yetkazadi.

words.definition: The act or fact of a person or thing ceasing to be visible or present.
words.definitionUz: One’s disappearance — biror kishi yoki narsaning ko‘rinmas yoki mavjud bo‘lmay qolishi.
words.example1: The police investigated one’s disappearance carefully.
words.example1Translation: Politsiya kimningdir g‘oyib bo‘lishini diqqat bilan tekshirdi.
words.example2: One’s disappearance left the family shocked.
words.example2Translation: Kimningdir g‘oyib bo‘lishi oilani hayratda qoldirdi.
words.example3: News of one’s disappearance spread quickly.
words.example3Translation: Kimningdir g‘oyib bo‘lishi haqidagi xabar tez tarqaldi.
extraExamples: One’s disappearance remains a mystery.
They reported one’s disappearance to the authorities.
One’s disappearance caused great concern.
The film is based on one’s disappearance.
One’s disappearance was never explained.
Friends noticed one’s disappearance last week.
One’s disappearance changed everything.
extraExampleTranslations: Kimningdir g‘oyib bo‘lishi sir bo‘lib qolmoqda.
Ular kimningdir g‘oyib bo‘lishini hokimiyatga xabar qildilar.
Kimningdir g‘oyib bo‘lishi katta tashvish uyg‘otdi.
Film kimningdir g‘oyib bo‘lishiga asoslangan.
Kimningdir g‘oyib bo‘lishi hech qachon tushuntirilmadi.
Do‘stlar o‘tgan hafta kimningdir g‘oyib bo‘lishini sezdilar.
Kimningdir g‘oyib bo‘lishi hamma narsani o‘zgartirdi.

words.definition: To produce results that affect many people or situations over a long time.
words.definitionUz: Have far-reaching consequences — ko‘p odamlarga yoki vaziyatlarga uzoq vaqt davomida ta’sir qiladigan natijalarni keltirib chiqarmoq.
words.example1: The decision will have far-reaching consequences for the economy.
words.example1Translation: Bu qaror iqtisodiyot uchun keng qamrovli oqibatlarga ega bo‘ladi.
words.example2: Pollution can have far-reaching consequences for health.
words.example2Translation: Ifloslanish sog‘liq uchun keng qamrovli oqibatlarga ega bo‘lishi mumkin.
words.example3Translation: Urush har doim keng qamrovli oqibatlarga ega.
extraExamples: Climate change will have far-reaching consequences.
The new law may have far-reaching consequences.
His actions had far-reaching consequences.
Technological advances have far-reaching consequences.
The accident had far-reaching consequences for the company.
Policy changes often have far-reaching consequences.
Deforestation can have far-reaching consequences.
extraExampleTranslations: Iqlim o‘zgarishi keng qamrovli oqibatlarga ega bo‘ladi.
Yangi qonun keng qamrovli oqibatlarga ega bo‘lishi mumkin.
Uning harakatlari keng qamrovli oqibatlarga ega bo‘ldi.
Texnologik yutuqlar keng qamrovli oqibatlarga ega.
Baxtsiz hodisa kompaniya uchun keng qamrovli oqibatlarga ega bo‘ldi.
Siyosat o‘zgarishlari ko‘pincha keng qamrovli oqibatlarga ega.
O‘rmonlarning kesilishi keng qamrovli oqibatlarga ega bo‘lishi mumkin.

words.definition: Having special features that allow survival or success only in a particular environment.
words.definitionUz: Uniquely adapted to — faqat ma’lum bir muhitda omon qolish yoki muvaffaqiyatga erishishga imkon beradigan maxsus xususiyatlarga ega bo‘lmoq.
words.example1: Camels are uniquely adapted to desert life.
words.example1Translation: Tuyalar cho‘l hayotiga o‘ziga xos tarzda moslashgan.
words.example2: These plants are uniquely adapted to cold climates.
words.example2Translation: Bu o‘simliklar sovuq iqlimga o‘ziga xos tarzda moslashgan.
words.example3: Penguins are uniquely adapted to Antarctic waters.
words.example3Translation: Pingvinlar Antarktika suvlariga o‘ziga xos tarzda moslashgan.
extraExamples: Cacti are uniquely adapted to dry conditions.
Deep-sea fish are uniquely adapted to high pressure.
Arctic foxes are uniquely adapted to snow.
Some insects are uniquely adapted to extreme heat.
Mountain goats are uniquely adapted to rocky slopes.
Mangroves are uniquely adapted to salty water.
Bats are uniquely adapted to flying at night.
extraExampleTranslations: Kaktuslar quruq sharoitga o‘ziga xos tarzda moslashgan.
Chuqur dengiz baliqlari yuqori bosimga o‘ziga xos tarzda moslashgan.
Arktika tulkilari qorga o‘ziga xos tarzda moslashgan.
Ba’zi hasharotlar ekstremal issiqlikka o‘ziga xos tarzda moslashgan.
Tog‘ echkilar qoyali yonbag‘irlarga o‘ziga xos tarzda moslashgan.
Mangrovlar sho‘r suvga o‘ziga xos tarzda moslashgan.
Ko‘rshapalaklar tunda uchishga o‘ziga xos tarzda moslashgan.

words.definition: The very harsh or severe environmental factors present in a particular place.
words.definitionUz: The extreme conditions of — ma’lum bir joydagi juda qattiq yoki og‘ir atrof-muhit omillari.
words.example1: Animals survive the extreme conditions of the Arctic.
words.example1Translation: Hayvonlar Arktikaning ekstremal sharoitlarida omon qoladi.
words.example2: Plants struggle in the extreme conditions of the desert.
words.example3: Explorers face the extreme conditions of high mountains.
words.example3Translation: Sayohatchilar baland tog‘larning ekstremal sharoitlariga duch keladi.
extraExamples: Life exists in the extreme conditions of deep oceans.
Scientists study the extreme conditions of volcanoes.
Equipment must withstand the extreme conditions of space.
People adapt to the extreme conditions of polar regions.
Bacteria thrive in the extreme conditions of hot springs.
Climbing requires dealing with the extreme conditions of altitude.
The team trained for the extreme conditions of the jungle.
extraExampleTranslations: Hayot chuqur okeanlarning ekstremal sharoitlarida mavjud.
Olimlar vulqonlarning ekstremal sharoitlarini o‘rganadi.
Uskunalar kosmosning ekstremal sharoitlariga bardosh berishi kerak.
Odamlar qutb hududlarining ekstremal sharoitlariga moslashadi.
Bakteriyalar issiq buloqlarning ekstremal sharoitlarida rivojlanadi.
Tirmashish balandlikning ekstremal sharoitlari bilan ishlashni talab qiladi.
Jamoa o‘rmonning ekstremal sharoitlari uchun mashq qildi.

words.definition: A single explanation or cause among others for a particular situation.
words.definitionUz: One reason for this — ma’lum bir vaziyat uchun boshqalar orasidan bitta tushuntirish yoki sabab.
words.example1: One reason for this is the lack of funding.
words.example2: One reason for this change is new technology.
words.example2Translation: Bu o‘zgarishning bir sababi yangi texnologiyadir.
words.example3: One reason for this problem is poor planning.
words.example3Translation: Bu muammoning bir sababi yomon rejalashtirishdir.
extraExamples: One reason for this success is hard work.
One reason for this decline is pollution.
One reason for this decision was safety.
One reason for this delay is bad weather.
One reason for this growth is education.
One reason for this failure is lack of experience.
One reason for this trend is social media.
extraExampleTranslations: Bu muvaffaqiyatning bir sababi mehnatsevarlikdir.
Bu pasayishning bir sababi ifloslanishdir.
Bu qarorning bir sababi xavfsizlik edi.
Bu kechikishning bir sababi yomon ob-havodir.
Bu o‘sishning bir sababi ta’limdir.
Bu muvaffaqiyatsizlikning bir sababi tajriba yetishmasligidir.
Bu tendentsiyaning bir sababi ijtimoiy tarmoqlardir.

words.definition: Located or occurring just below the surface of the skin.
words.definitionUz: Underneath one’s skin — terining yuzasidan biroz pastroqda joylashgan yoki sodir bo‘ladigan.
words.example1: Fat is stored underneath one’s skin.
words.example2: The injection goes underneath one’s skin.
words.example3: Blood vessels run underneath one’s skin.
extraExamples: Nerves lie underneath one’s skin.
The cream absorbs underneath one’s skin.
Muscles are found underneath one’s skin.
A rash can appear underneath one’s skin.
Doctors examine what is underneath one’s skin.
Sweat glands are underneath one’s skin.
The tattoo ink sits underneath one’s skin.
extraExampleTranslations: Asablar teri ostida joylashgan.
Krem teri ostiga singib ketadi.
Muskullar teri ostida joylashgan.
Toshma teri ostida paydo bo‘lishi mumkin.
Shifokorlar teri ostidagi narsani tekshiradi.
Ter bezlari teri ostida joylashgan.
Tatuirovka siyohi teri ostida qoladi.

words.definition: Relative amounts or degrees of something when measured against others.
words.definitionUz: Comparative levels of — boshqalar bilan solishtirilganda o‘lchanadigan nisbiy miqdorlar yoki darajalar.
words.example1: Scientists compare comparative levels of pollution.
words.example2: The study shows comparative levels of stress.
words.example3: We measured comparative levels of education.
extraExamples: Comparative levels of income vary by region.
They analyzed comparative levels of fitness.
Comparative levels of biodiversity are important.
The report includes comparative levels of rainfall.
Comparative levels of carbon dioxide are rising.
Doctors check comparative levels of cholesterol.
Comparative levels of happiness differ across countries.
extraExampleTranslations: Daromadning solishtirma darajalari mintaqaga qarab farq qiladi.
Ular jismoniy tayyorgarlikning solishtirma darajalarini tahlil qildilar.
Bioxilma-xillikning solishtirma darajalari muhim.
Hisobot yog‘ingarchilikning solishtirma darajalarini o‘z ichiga oladi.
Karbonat angidridning solishtirma darajalari oshmoqda.
Shifokorlar xolesterinning solishtirma darajalarini tekshiradi.
Baxtning solishtirma darajalari mamlakatlar bo‘yicha farq qiladi.

words.definition: Body tissue that stores fat and helps insulate and protect organs.
words.definitionUz: Adipose tissue — yog‘ni saqlaydigan, organlarni izolyatsiya qilish va himoya qilishga yordam beradigan tana to‘qimasi.
words.example1: Adipose tissue stores energy for the body.
words.example1Translation: Yog‘ to‘qimasi tana uchun energiya saqlaydi.
words.example2: Too much adipose tissue can lead to health problems.
words.example2Translation: Ortiqcha yog‘ to‘qimasi sog‘liq muammolariga olib kelishi mumkin.
words.example3: Doctors measure adipose tissue during exams.
words.example3Translation: Shifokorlar tekshiruv paytida yog‘ to‘qimasini o‘lchaydi.
extraExamples: Adipose tissue is found under the skin.
Exercise can reduce adipose tissue.
Adipose tissue acts as insulation.
Hormones affect adipose tissue levels.
Scientists study adipose tissue carefully.
Adipose tissue surrounds vital organs.
Diet influences the amount of adipose tissue.
extraExampleTranslations: Yog‘ to‘qimasi teri ostida joylashgan.
Mashqlar yog‘ to‘qimasini kamaytirishi mumkin.
Yog‘ to‘qimasi izolyatsiya vazifasini bajaradi.
Gormonlar yog‘ to‘qimasi darajasiga ta’sir qiladi.
Olimlar yog‘ to‘qimasini diqqat bilan o‘rganadi.
Yog‘ to‘qimasi muhim organlarni o‘rab turadi.
Parhez yog‘ to‘qimasi miqdoriga ta’sir qiladi.
